tools.description: Windows PTY interface for running console programs in MSYS2 terminals
tools.usage: winpty python\nwinpty cmd\nwinpty ssh user@host

tools.description: Background agent process for winpty terminal interface functionality
tools.usage: winpty-agent\nwinpty-agent --help\necho 'Started by winpty automatically'

tools.description: Debug server for troubleshooting winpty terminal issues
tools.usage: winpty-debugserver\nwinpty-debugserver --port 8080\nwinpty-debugserver --help

tools.description: Tk windowing shell for creating GUI applications with Tcl/Tk
tools.usage: wish gui_script.tcl\nwish -c 'button .b -text "Hello" -command exit; pack .b'\nwish8.6

tools.description: Tk 8.6 windowing shell for GUI development with enhanced features
tools.usage: wish86 gui_app.tcl\nwish86 -c 'wm title . "My App"; button .b -text "Click"; pack .b'\nwish86 --version

tools.description: Approximate pattern matching utility for fuzzy text searching
tools.usage: x86_64-w64-mingw32-agrep 'patern' file.txt\nx86_64-w64-mingw32-agrep -2 'approximate' document.txt\nx86_64-w64-mingw32-agrep -i 'CasE' text.txt

tools.description: Execute commands with arguments from standard input
tools.usage: find . -name '*.txt' | xargs grep 'pattern'\necho 'file1 file2' | xargs rm\nls *.log | xargs -I {} cp {} backup/

tools.description: XML well-formedness checker and parser using Expat library
tools.usage: xmlwf document.xml\nxmlwf -d output_dir *.xml\nxmlwf -c config.xml

tools.description: Hexdump utility for displaying binary files in hexadecimal format
tools.usage: xxd binary_file\nxxd -l 32 file.dat\necho 'Hello' | xxd

tools.description: XZ compression utility with LZMA2 algorithm for high compression ratios
tools.usage: xz file.txt\nxz -9 --extreme largefile.dat\nxz -d compressed.xz

tools.description: Display contents of XZ compressed files without decompressing to disk
tools.usage: xzcat archive.xz\nxzcat compressed.tar.xz | tar -t\nxzcat *.xz | grep pattern

tools.description: Small XZ decompression utility with minimal memory requirements
tools.usage: xzdec < compressed.xz > output.txt\nxzdec compressed.xz\ncat file.xz | xzdec

tools.description: Yet Another Texi to Man converter for generating manual pages
tools.usage: yat2m program.texi\nyat2m --source program.texi > program.1\nyat2m --help

tools.description: Output string repeatedly until terminated (default: y)
tools.usage: yes\nyes 'delete all files' | head -5\nyes n | some_interactive_command

tools.description: Display detailed information about ZIP archive contents and structure
tools.usage: zipinfo archive.zip\nzipinfo -l archive.zip\nzipinfo -h archive.zip
